findings.original_problem: The proof indexes arbitrary K through a category whose source objects must be termwise bounded below.
findings.correction: Use the full K/Qis(A); its indicated bounded-target subcategory is cofinal.

findings.original_problem: The image induction applies the computing lemma to nonsplit short exact sequences and falsely concludes all images are acyclic for arbitrary additive F.
findings.correction: Use the acyclic complex zero-object value and the already proved Leray lemma. The full counterexample has F(M)=M[p]/D(M)[p] and the exact four-term complex Z to Z to Q/Z to Q/Z.

findings.original_problem: Canonical lower truncation changes the bottom term, whose acyclicity was not established in the proof.
findings.correction: Use the original-term truncation with n>=max(1,N), prove the exact tail bound, and retain the comparison to canonical truncation through the image sheaf J[n].
